What it does

No instrument repairs a culture. Dojo trains leaders in the one technology that never ages: criterion.

  • Discipline: repeated practice, not episodic motivation.
  • Method: the same sequence, applied until it becomes reflex.
  • Culture: the standard that holds when nobody is watching.
  • Continuous improvement: the cycle that rises with every turn.
Status

Delivered in person and remotely. Transmission between people, not by machine.
